bsp_mobile.name: BSP-Mobile
item.bsp_mobile.mobile_engine.tooltip: Aboard a construct: more acceleration and top speed, one engine's worth each.
item.bsp_mobile.mobile_floater.tooltip: Aboard a construct: more buoyancy, so a heavy hull floats.
item.bsp_mobile.mobile_balloon.tooltip: Aboard a construct: lift. Enough balloons for its mass and the construct hovers; space climbs, sprint and space descends.
item.bsp_mobile.mobile_wing.tooltip: Aboard a construct: lift from speed. Fly it fast and level and the wings carry it.
item.bsp_mobile.mobile_jet_engine.toolti: Aboard a construct: four engines' worth of thrust, and lift to climb (space).
item.bsp_mobile.mobile_helm.tooltip: Stand at it aboard an assembled construct to drive: W and S thrust, A and D turn, sprint doubles the thrust, sneak steps away.
message.bsp_mobile.helm.locked: This construct is locked by its owner.
message.bsp_mobile.helm.taken: Someone is already at this helm.
message.bsp_mobile.helm.no_core: This construct has no Mobile Core.
message.bsp_mobile.core.broken: %s broke up: its Mobile Core was destroyed.
message.bsp_mobile.core.derelict: %s lost its Mobile Core and lies where it is; place a new core in it to drive it again.
command.bsp_mobile.removed: Construct #%s (%s) set down where it stood.
command.bsp_mobile.remove_failed: Construct #%s could not be set down (%s); add delete to remove it with its blocks.
command.bsp_mobile.limits: Constructs: %s of %s on this server (%s per player); allowance by tier %s; impact speed %s; this server %s.
command.bsp_mobile.pasted: %s pasted as construct #%s (%s blocks), owned by you, parked.
item.bsp_mobile.part.tooltip: A part of the Mobile Core.
item.bsp_mobile.mobile_core_lock.tooltip: Right-click a Mobile Core to bind it to you. Your team may still use it; anyone else must steal it.
message.bsp_mobile.steal.warning: %s is stealing your Mobile Core %s! %s minutes to stop them.
message.bsp_mobile.steal.begun: You are stealing %s from %s. Stay within %s blocks for %s minutes.
message.bsp_mobile.steal.saved: The steal of your Mobile Core %s failed.
gui.bsp_mobile.core.title: Mobile core
gui.bsp_mobile.helm.heading: Heading
gui.bsp_mobile.helm.helms_none: No helm aboard. Place a Mobile Helm on the construct to drive it.
gui.bsp_mobile.helm.anchor_down: Anchor: down · the construct stands where it is.
gui.bsp_mobile.helm.anchor_up: Anchor: weighed · the construct parks itself soon after it stops with nobody at a helm.
gui.bsp_mobile.helm.totem_cap: A totem aboard caps the speed at %s blocks a second.
gui.bsp_mobile.helm.not_assembled: Assemble the construct to drive it.
gui.bsp_mobile.helm.closed_region: Closed region: the construct can only back out.
gui.bsp_mobile.helm.parts: Parts: %s engines · %s floaters · %s balloons · %s wings · %s jets
gui.bsp_mobile.helm.parts_none: No parts aboard: the helm alone drives it on land and water.
gui.bsp_mobile.helm.lift: Lift carries %s of %s blocks of mass
gui.bsp_mobile.plan.header_way: Flight plan · under way to %s of %s
gui.bsp_mobile.plan.empty: No waypoints. Walk or fly the route and press ADD HERE at each turn; the last waypoint is the landing.
gui.bsp_mobile.plan.hint: A waypoint counts within 4 blocks. At the last one the construct stops and parks itself, and the core gives a redstone pulse. A driver at a helm, STOP, or a closed region stops the plan.
gui.bsp_mobile.name: Name
gui.bsp_mobile.too_many: More than %s blocks touch this core. Build smaller, or upgrade the core.
gui.bsp_mobile.note.idle: Blocks touching this core, counted now. The outline shows them.
gui.bsp_mobile.note.parked: The construct's blocks. Build onto it and the count follows.
gui.bsp_mobile.steal.paused: %s is stealing this core · paused, thief away · %s left
gui.bsp_mobile.blocks.header: What the core takes · %s of %s · %s kinds
gui.bsp_mobile.blocks.footer: Blocks the core refuses: bedrock and anything that cannot be mined, another Mobile Core, admin blocks and Anti Totem blocks, and blocks the engine lists as unmovable.
gui.bsp_mobile.upgrade.short: Not enough coins carried. Anyone at the core may buy a tier.
gui.bsp_mobile.upgrade.enough: Anyone at the core may buy a tier. Coins are taken from the buyer, with change.
gui.bsp_mobile.upgrade.at_top: This core carries as much as a core can.
gui.bsp_mobile.upgrade.locked: Locked: only the owner and their team may buy a tier.
gui.bsp_mobile.note.assemble.ok: Assembled. The construct stands where it was built.
gui.bsp_mobile.note.release.ok: Released. The blocks are back in the world.
gui.bsp_mobile.note.fail.price: No price is set for this tier.
gui.bsp_mobile.note.unlock.ok: Unlocked. The lock is back in your inventory.
gui.bsp_mobile.note.fail.closed_region: Constructs may not be assembled here.
gui.bsp_mobile.note.fail.limit_server: This server carries as many constructs as it allows.
gui.bsp_mobile.note.fail.limit_player: You own as many constructs as a player may.
gui.bsp_mobile.note.steal.ok: The steal has begun. Stay within reach of the core.
gui.bsp_mobile.note.fail.too_many: Too many blocks for this tier.
gui.bsp_mobile.note.fail.blocked: No room to set the blocks down.
gui.bsp_mobile.note.fail.height: Too high or too low to set the blocks down.
gui.bsp_mobile.note.fail.name: A name is needed.
